messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for tenant cedar-soft on dedicated cluster cedar-3. Spike started ~12:02 UTC. Symptoms: 503 gateway errors, gRPC timeouts, p95 latency up. Impacting ~18-25% of requests. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/cedar-3/tenant/cedar-soft · paging oncall.
oncall-nyc: oncall-nyc here, taking it. paging SRE @sre-maya and runtime @eng-runtime-josh. putting incident channel in incident mode :rotating_light:
sre-maya: I'm on it. looking at kv cache evictions and pod restarts. grabbing top-20 tenants by tokens/sec.
eng-runtime-josh: joining. preliminary: heavy KV eviction + GPU mem pressure. long sequence lengths from cedar-soft plus an unrelated high-throughput job from tenant noisy-tenant-42.
support-hannah: support heads-up: I'm DMing CedarSoft ops, telling them we're investigating and will share mitigation steps. gathering request ids from their last 15 minutes.
cust-cedar-ops: Thanks. We didn't push any changes. Our side shows increased 503s and timeouts starting ~12:02 UTC. Users report failures on inference requests.
eng-platform-raj: checked autoscaler logs — cedar-3 had node allocation failures for ~4m due to insufficient GPU pool. there are pending node requests stuck in provisioning queue.
sre-maya: short-term mitigations: 1) route a portion of cedar-soft traffic to cedar-2, 2) evict the noisy tenant on cedar-3, 3) temporarily reduce batch_size for cedar-soft to lower memory pressure.
eng-runtime-josh: I see a long-running batching job from noisy-tenant-42 with huge batch_size overrides. can evict that tenant. command: ```bash
/redwood/ops evict-tenant --cluster cedar-3 --tenant noisy-tenant-42 --force
``` initiating now.
oncall-nyc: go for it. @eng-runtime-josh kick it off. @support-hannah coordinate comms with CedarSoft. I'll watch the routing changes.
eng-runtime-josh: eviction started -> draining connections -> evicted. pod terminated for noisy-tenant-42. GPU utilization dropping from 92% -> 68% within 90s.
incident-bot: ACTION: routing rule applied: cedar-soft primary -> cedar-2, fallback -> cedar-3. traffic shifted 40% initially, rate-limited to 30rps while monitoring. link: https://redwood.internal/routing/cedar-soft
product-lina: keep customer updated. this is customer-visible; no rolling restarts of customer workloads unless necessary.
support-hannah: Message sent to CedarSoft ops: "We've rerouted a portion of your traffic to healthier capacity and evicted a noisy tenant on cedar-3. Monitoring closely, will DM logs and RCA timeline." They acknowledged.
cust-cedar-ops: We're seeing errors drop to ~5% now. Some retries succeed. Thanks for the quick action.
eng-platform-raj: autoscaler backlog cleared after eviction; new nodes are provisioning successfully. follow-up: needs root cause for allocation failures (quota / provider spot interruptions?).
sre-maya: follow-up action items (short): 1) post-incident traffic-shaping rules for cedar-3, 2) increase kv cache target for cedar-soft, 3) quota/enforcement checks for noisy tenants, 4) autoscaler hardening ticket.
eng-runtime-josh: while eviction helped, I'm also enabling a temporary model fallback on cedar-3: smaller quantized variant for cedar-soft to reduce mem pressure. canary running at ~10% traffic on cedar-3.
support-hannah: handing monitoring to @oncall-eu for the next 2h (their day). I'll update the support ticket and the customer with timeline.
oncall-eu: taken. I'll watch errors and latency for 2h; alert if errors >10% sustained.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rates returned to baseline after mitigations. current 5xx ~1-2%. No further customer complaints. severity: prod-impacting, customer-visible. Postmortem requested. Pager ticket: ENG-INC-4897 · responder: sre-maya.
sre-maya: recording notes for postmortem. likely root cause: tenant-level unconstrained batching + autoscaler allocation hiccup -> KV evictions -> GPU pressure -> 5xx cascade. next: quota enforcement for batch overrides + autoscaler retry logic.
eng-runtime-josh: will open an RFC for tenant-level limits and eviction automation. also prepare a runbook snippet: ```yaml
mitigation:
  - evict noisy tenant
  - route traffic to healthy cluster
  - reduce batch_size
  - enable fallback model
```
product-lina: good. please include customer comms draft for postmortem. Support: share with CedarSoft pre-rca.
support-hannah: will draft. handing this back to oncall-nyc for final wrap.
oncall-nyc: wrapping: incident closed, monitoring continues. :thumbsup: great cross-team response.
